site.name: Alva Mine
site.componentDetail: Named historic mine shown on Keystone topographic mapping
overview: Alva Mine is a named historic mine locality in Summit County shown on the Keystone topographic quadrangle. The mapped feature is at approximately 39.54860, -105.90557 in the high country east of Keystone.
Remnant uses the mapped mine locality for identification only. The record does not claim that a surviving opening is accessible, open, or safe.
